title: Root-Zone Water Content, Dryback, Runoff & Crop Steering
description: Specialist module covering root-zone water status, dryback trajectories, runoff/return interpretation, crop-steering logic and controlled root-zone reporting.
learningOutcomes: Interpret root-zone water content as a spatial and temporal state influenced by substrate/media properties, container geometry, root development, irrigation delivery and environmental demand.
Calculate and analyze dryback as a trajectory between verified measurements rather than treating elapsed time or one percentage as a universal target.
Use runoff or return volume and chemistry together with input, root-zone and delivery evidence to distinguish drainage, preferential flow, concentration and sampling effects.
Evaluate crop-steering adjustments from measured root-zone, environment and crop response while preserving study/system boundaries and avoiding universal recipes.
Produce a reconstructable root-zone steering report that states baseline, intervention, measured response, uncertainty, acceptance limits and authorized next action.
